# Solana Web3.js Release Notes - v2.0.0

## What's Changed in @solana/web3.js v2.0.0
- Rebuilt from the ground up using async transaction building.
- Deprecated legacy `Transaction` class constructors in favor of functional pipeline `buildTransaction()`.
- Applications upgrading to @solana/web3.js v2.0 must update RPC connection interfaces to use modular transport providers.
- Fixed buffer serialization overflow bug in legacy instruction encoding.
